files.agent.patch.yml:
- id: llm-pi-ai
  config:
    providers:
      llamacpp:
        apiKeyEnv: LLAMACPP_API_KEY
        api: openai-completions
        baseURL: http://127.0.0.1:8081/v1
        models:
          - id: bonsai
            contextWindow: 131072
            maxTokens: 16384
- id: acp
  config:
    provider: llamacpp
    model: bonsai
- insert:
    - id: mcp-pubmed
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: pubmed
        transport: stdio
        command: /home/YOU/.local/share/uv/tools/pubmed-search-mcp/bin/pubmed-search-mcp
        args: []
        env:
          NCBI_EMAIL: you@example.com
        toolCallTimeoutMs: 120000
    - id: llama-mcp-router
      name: '/home/YOU/agent-runtimes/dsh/plugins/llama-mcp-router.mjs'
      config:
        routerUrl: http://127.0.0.1:8001
        servers: [pubmed]
        startupWaitMs: 20000
        policy: session
        always: [mcp__pubmed__unified_search, mcp__pubmed__fetch_article_details]
        instructions: tool
        hide: [workflow, create_goal, get_goal, update_goal, subagent_fork, list_agents, send_message, interrupt_agent, list_mcp_resources, list_mcp_resource_templates, read_mcp_resource, read_image, web_search, exit_plan_mode]
